title: Preserve the previous export proof across the journal replacement crash window
outcome: Preserve the previous export proof across the journal replacement crash window
acceptance: After a crash where a replacement journal was written but its new head never committed, the previous published exact-HEAD proof remains recoverable and ordinary export or import can confirm it instead of requiring export --rebuild
The implementation retains the previous slot bytes or uses an equivalent two-slot handoff without changing journal ownership, exact head matching or comparison-basis rules
A deterministic crash-at-retention regression covers the previous published proof and proves no data loss and no inexact adoption
The fix adds no per-task Git launches, durable format conversion or new gate
